name: look-codex
description: Looks and works like the Codex desktop app (light): a gray translucent sidebar of threads by project with relative times, a white page, your prompts in gray pills, the reply as plain text, a large rounded white composer.

files.themes/codex-app.json:
// The Codex app: a gray sidebar beside a white page, near-black text, gray accents, no borders.
{
  "name": "Codex app",
  "description": "A gray sidebar beside a white page, near-black text, no borders.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "colors": { "background": "#ffffff", "foreground": "#0d0d0d", "selection": "#e3e3e3", "accent": "#5d5d5d" },
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.accent": "neutral",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#d9d9d9",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.92,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",

  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
